data.one_liner: A simple on‑screen numeric keyboard widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ready‑made numeric keypad that can be placed in the UI. It sends tapped values via a callback so the app can update its own text state. Works on Android, iOS, web and desktop.
use_when: You need a custom numeric input UI instead of the system keyboard
You want a lightweight, plug‑and‑play keypad for forms or PIN entry
avoid_when: You require extensive styling or theming beyond the provided options
You need advanced features like input validation, locale‑aware number formats, or accessibility support
strengths: Cross‑platform support out of the box
weaknesses: Limited customization of layout and appearance
No built‑in validation or formatting logic
